title: Clocking in on a work order line depends on the per-staff Time Clock setting
preconds:
1. User C (Technician) has the per-staff Time Clock setting ON.
  2. User D (Technician) has the per-staff Time Clock setting OFF.
steps:
1. Log in as User C, open an assigned work order and find a labor line.
  2. Click the clock-in control on that line and see what happens.
  3. Log in as User D, open an assigned work order and find a labor line.
  4. Look for the clock-in control on that line.
expected:
User C can clock in on the line and it starts recording time.

User D has no clock-in control on labor lines (or it is disabled).

Same role, different per-staff setting, different behavior.
